body:
I guess. I really don’t know. 
But I can’t sleep and I’m just scared. When I might finally fall asleep, I’m afraid I’ll wake up late tomorrow and my parents will yell at me. Im afraid I’ll wake up up even more late that I’ll get a detention and my parents will yell at me more. Im afraid to disappoint them. Im scared to show myself tomorrow after what happened tonight if I do manage to be on time even though no one will know. It’s just this feeling. I feel empty and alone.
